unit: up to three listed vocational-school pathways, study mode, type/major, part-time status, program duration, graduation and diploma outcomes
value_labels: The questionnaire distinguishes evening classes, self-study examination, correspondence, radio/TV university, formal school and other routes. Institution type and part-time status follow formal schooling; alternative routes have a separate major/duration/diploma sequence. Up to three vocational schools are represented in the structured fields.
value_label_status: official route logic and Codebook field identities reviewed; repeated-school sequence and authorized-release coding require QA
mapping_status: candidate metadata mapped to official 2014 Life History Codebook; not analysis-ready
caveat: Do not collapse distinct study modes or treat a diploma as equivalent across routes without review. Fields are repeated by school slot; E050e/E050f/E051/E054/E055 follow formal-school route, while E056b fields follow specified nonformal routes. Free-text majors, school names and addresses are excluded. 2014 special Life History survey; retrospective self-report. The official release note states that no weight is provided. Do not pool into regular-wave weighted pairwise analyses without a separately justified target population and linkage/design plan.

unit: select-all status indicators by inter-job interval
value_labels: Unemployment seeking/not seeking work, illness, childbirth, care of children/grandchildren/elderly/other family, leisure/travel, training, prison, schooling, or other.
value_label_status: official questionnaire gap detection and response routes, multi-select categories and Codebook interval identities reviewed; authorized-release checkbox coding requires QA
mapping_status: candidate metadata mapped to official 2014 Life History Codebook; not analysis-ready
caveat: F_6 is asked for a gap after F_5 confirms no work during the interval; if F_5 indicates work, the interviewer returns to F_2 to add the omitted job. Preserve the interval suffix and multi-select design. F_5 is an interviewer completeness check, not a respondent exposure, and is excluded from E/P. ‘Other’ write-in is unmapped; blank/skip does not mean no status. These are interval-level life-course contexts, not environmental exposure or disease diagnoses. 2014 special Life History survey; retrospective self-report. The official release note states that no weight is provided. Do not pool into regular-wave weighted pairwise analyses without a separately justified target population and linkage/design plan.
